title: One Car Photo Three Sizes
tests: Tests delivering three distinct aspect-ratio adaptations of one source while keeping the complete subject in every version.

faults.what: The 4:5 feed image clips the rear end of the car at the right edge.
The 9:16 stories image severely crops both ends of the car, removing the front wheel and portions of the front and rear body instead of using padding to preserve the whole vehicle.

judge.summary: Three separate, appropriately shaped images were delivered, but the feed and stories crops fail to keep the whole car visible.

must_haves.item: Three separate images are delivered, rather than one collage.
must_haves.why: There are three distinct output images.

must_haves.item: The three frames have ratios of 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 respectively.
must_haves.why: The outputs have the requested square, feed portrait, and stories portrait frame shapes.

must_haves.item: Every version shows the same red hatchback from the attached photo.
must_haves.why: All three are recognizable crops of the supplied red hatchback photo.

must_haves.item: The complete car, including roof, wheels and both ends, is visible in every version.
must_haves.why: The square preserves the whole car, but the feed clips its rear end and the stories crop cuts off both ends and the front wheel.

must_haves.item: The car retains its original proportions and appearance in all versions.
must_haves.why: The visible car details retain the source appearance and proportions; the problem is cropping rather than distortion.

must_haves.item: Any padding is a blurred version of the source photo, and no version contains added text.
must_haves.why: No padding or added text is visible.
